overviewChannelLead: FOCAL WCM unifies creating, managing, and publishing web content so the right people see the right message at the right time—with stronger editorial productivity.
overviewChannelUnified: Deliver coherent experiences across channels; routine updates stay with business teams instead of IT backlogs.
officialBenefits: Publish or refresh pages with minimal effort.
Steer look-and-feel and page content from one stack.
Schedule go-live by date, time, or recurring slots.
Extensions grow capability without replacing the core.
modulesSidebarSummary: Editorial tooling plus ready-made modules—navigation, media, search, syndication—so teams publish coherent sites without serial IT dependency.
modulesSidebarBenefits: Steer presentation and page content together.
Site-wide search and room to extend.
modulesFooterNote: Mirrors the public module list—confirm packaging with FDS for your programme.

workflowSteps.desc: Contributors compose articles and plug in modular components (news flashes, banners, HTML blocks) aligned to their permissions.
Editors validate tone, links, and placement before modules appear in navigation slots—keeping public messaging coherent.
Use scheduling to align go-live moments with campaigns or maintenance windows instead of manual redeploy rituals.
Automated archival preserves historical pages by period while the outward-facing site emphasises fresh, authoritative content.

productFeatures.title: Central Storage
productFeatures.desc: Keeps pages, modules, and media flowing through one governed staging posture—reducing drift between environments while editors iterate on site-wide presentation.

productFeatures.title: Web Content Archive
productFeatures.desc: Archives web content automatically on a pre-defined schedule—by month or year—so the live site stays current while historical pages remain available for internal and external obligations.

productFeatures.title: Banners and Feeds Management
productFeatures.desc: Configure banners and feeds for business needs: define display windows, caps on impressions or clicks before retirement, and varied promotional placements.

productFeatures.title: Custom HTML
productFeatures.desc: Author custom modules containing HTML-based content—text, imagery, and links—where bespoke layout is required alongside structured components.

productFeatures.title: Multiple Accounts
productFeatures.desc: Multiple editorial accounts so designated contributors change only the sections they own—reducing accidental cross-site edits.

productFeatures.title: Menu Manager
productFeatures.desc: Ready-to-use menu templates to define site navigation without rebuilding markup by hand each time.

productFeatures.title: Most read & latest news
productFeatures.desc: Surface the most-read articles alongside the newest additions so high-interest stories stay visible.

productFeatures.title: News flash
productFeatures.desc: Presents content items drawn from configured section/category lists for timely announcements.

productFeatures.title: Polls
productFeatures.desc: Front-end delivery for the polls component—visitor input captured where your templates expose it.

productFeatures.title: Random image
productFeatures.desc: Rotate imagery from a nominated folder to keep landing zones visually fresh within governed libraries.

productFeatures.title: Related items
productFeatures.desc: Uses metadata keywords to recommend sibling articles—deepening topical journeys without manual link curation for every page.

productFeatures.title: Search
productFeatures.desc: Lets visitors launch a basic search from their current location and jump straight into results.

productFeatures.title: Sections
productFeatures.desc: Lists article sections configured in the site structure so browsing stays aligned with your taxonomy.

productFeatures.title: Syndicate
productFeatures.desc: Shows feed types available for syndication—making outbound content programmes easier to discover.

productFeatures.title: Wrapper
productFeatures.desc: Embeds another page by URL inside a chosen module position—useful for bridging legacy tools or external microsites.

channelHighlights: Single integrated backbone for immersive experiences across your digital surface area—not isolated microsites per initiative.
Business-led publishing cycles decouple everyday updates from central IT backlog risk.
Composable modules (polls, feeds, related reading, wrappers) extend functionality without abandoning governance templates.
Scheduling plus archival pairs outward freshness with internal retention discipline.
Central storage underpins repeatable layouts, predictable deployments, and fewer “snowflake” environments.
guardrailsBody: Multiple accounts, modular placements, scheduling, and archival routines combine so contributors move quickly without forfeiting visibility into what is live, what is staged, and what must be retained.
ctaBandLead: Pair editorial autonomy with the modular depth Hong Kong enterprises expect from the broader FOCAL portfolio.
